technical.summary: Short-term momentum is bullish with price above key moving averages and supertrend confirmation, but extreme RSI(9) overbought conditions, weak ADX trend strength, and longer-term downtrend below 200-day MA create significant pullback risk unsuitable for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: IQV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 21 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 17) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 sale, 1 purchase, 1 sale) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (369.28), flat yield curve signals recession risk, strong dollar pressures multinational healthcare revenues, and earnings event in 21 days compounds volatility risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum is bullish with price above EMA 9/21/50, supertrend confirmation, and extreme fear sentiment presents contrarian buy opportunity near support at 211.16.
debate.key_bear_argument: RSI(9) extreme overbought at 85.24, weak ADX trend strength (16.9), price below 200-day MA indicating longer-term downtrend, high earnings risk in 21 days, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, strong dollar, flat yield curve) create unacceptable pullback and volatility risk.

decision.entry_rationale: While price sits at support (211.16) with short-term momentum bullish, extreme RSI overbought (85.24) and weak ADX (16.9) signal imminent pullback risk unsuitable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: RSI(9) extreme overbought combined with earnings event in 21 days and VIX crisis conditions create high probability of sharp pullback before any upside realization.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 73 positions in Health Care sector (26% of portfolio); adding IQV increases concentration risk without fundamental or institutional conviction to justify it.
